title: InsurancePolicy
description: Insurance policy record linked to a patient. Used by Pre-Visit Agent for format validation, Billing Agent for expiry checks and coverage matching.

policyId.description: Internal unique identifier for this policy record.

policyNumber.description: Insurance policy number. Required format: POL-XX-XXXXXXXX (e.g., POL-MY-20230415). Pre-Visit Agent validates this pattern.

coveragePlan.description: Name or code of the coverage plan (e.g., 'Basic', 'Premium', 'Corporate-A').

coveredCodes.description: List of treatment/procedure codes covered under this plan. Billing Agent checks treatment codes against this list to detect mismatches.

remainingBalance.description: Remaining coverage balance for current period.

expiryDate.description: Policy expiration date. Billing Agent validates this is not in the past at time of claim submission. Expired policy = claim rejected.

status.description: Current policy status. Only 'active' policies are valid for claims.

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp of last verification with insurance provider.
